replies.body:
Hello,

Thank you for the report, 
However, the player is not Fly Hacking - the blocks have simply not loaded for you, which you can tell by: 
  • the blocks looking glitched
  • him doing a normal jump run animation
  • blocks not rendered for you
Regards,
Tazz // Avicus Network Moderator
